item.title: 微信回应 iPhone Duo 适配：正积极推进，将尽快更新
item.guid: 微信回应-iPhone-Duo-适配：正积极推进，将尽快更新
item.description:
Apple's first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, will officially go on sale on October 23, and WeChat adaptation issues also topped the hot search list on the eve of its release. 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 将于 10 月 23 日正式开售，微信适配问题也在发售前夕冲上热搜。

According to CBN, Tencent customer service responded that WeChat is actively promoting the adaptation of Apple's foldable devices, will release relevant updates as soon as possible, and continuously optimize the user experience. However, the specific progress and update time have not yet been clarified. 据第一财经报道，腾讯客服回应称，微信正在积极推进苹果可折叠设备的适配，将尽快推出相关更新，并持续优化使用体验。不过，具体进度和更新时间暂未明确。

During the actual experience of iPhone Duo, iFanr also found that WeChat's interface adaptation on iPhone Duo is still not in place, and the large screen space cannot be fully utilized after unfolding the inner screen. 在实际体验 iPhone Duo 时，爱范儿也发现，微信在 iPhone Duo 上的界面适配仍不到位，展开内屏后暂时无法充分利用大屏空间。

🔗 Related reading: First Release | We used iPhone Duo for a week, here's everything you care about 🔗 相关阅读： 首发｜我们用了一周的 iPhone Duo，这里有你关心的一切

item.title: 奥迪中国换帅，前奇瑞高管张俊将接任总裁
item.guid: 奥迪中国换帅，前奇瑞高管张俊将接任总裁
item.description:
Audi announced that Jeff Zhang will take over as President of Audi China, replacing Johannes Roscheck, effective November 1. Roscheck will return to Germany. 奥迪宣布，自 11 月 1 日起，张俊（Jeff Zhang）将出任奥迪中国总裁，接替 Johannes Roscheck。后者将返回德国。

According to Reuters, Zhang Jun most recently served as CEO of Chery Brand's overseas business. Rolf Michl, who will co-lead the China business with him, will take office as COO of Audi China on the same day; Michl previously served as Managing Director of Audi Sport GmbH. 据路透社报道，张俊最近曾任奇瑞品牌海外业务 CEO。与他共同领导中国业务的 Rolf Michl 将于同日出任奥迪中国 COO；Michl 此前担任 Audi Sport GmbH 董事总经理。

The change in leadership comes as Audi faces competition and sales pressure in the Chinese market. Audi CEO Gernot Döllner stated that the new team's goal is to implement the company's strategy, respond more quickly to customer needs, and continuously enhance competitiveness. 此次换帅发生在奥迪面临中国市场竞争和销量压力之际。奥迪 CEO Gernot Döllner 表示，新团队的目标是贯彻公司战略，更快回应客户需求，并持续增强竞争力。

item.title: eBay 再裁约 1000 个岗位，年内第二轮收缩
item.guid: eBay-再裁约-1000-个岗位，年内第二轮收缩
item.description:
According to a Reuters report on October 21, eBay CEO Jamie Iannone informed employees in an internal memo that the company would cut about 9% of its positions to streamline operations and shift resources to its fastest-growing businesses. An eBay spokesperson confirmed the layoffs to Reuters. 据路透社 10 月 21 日报道，eBay CEO Jamie Iannone 在内部备忘录中告知员工，公司将裁减约 9% 的岗位，以简化运营，并把资源转向增长最快的业务。eBay 发言人向路透社确认了裁员。

Jiemian News cited the company's statement to the media, saying that this round involves about 1,000-1,100 positions. The company hopes to align its personnel and resource allocation more closely with strategic priorities. 界面新闻援引公司向媒体的表态称，此次涉及约 1000—1100 个岗位。公司希望让人员与资源配置更贴合战略重点。

This is eBay's second round of layoffs this year. In February, the company already cut about 800 people, accounting for about 6% of its total workforce at the time. In recent years, eBay has shifted its business focus to authenticated luxury goods, collectibles, and refurbished items, aiming to attract enthusiasts willing to pay for high-value items. 这是 eBay 今年第二轮裁员。2 月，公司已裁减约 800 人，约占当时员工总数的 6%。近年 eBay 将业务重点转向经过鉴定的奢侈品、收藏品和翻新商品，争取愿意为高价值物品付费的爱好者。

item.title: 比亚迪杨冬生：L3 级自动驾驶可能在 2028 年落地
item.guid: 比亚迪杨冬生：L3-级自动驾驶可能在-2028-年落地
item.description:
According to CBN, Yang Dongsheng, Senior Vice President of BYD Group and President of the Automotive New Technology Research Institute, stated at the World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference on October 21 that L3 conditional autonomous driving is expected to be implemented in 2028. 据第一财经报道，比亚迪集团高级副总裁、汽车新技术研究院院长杨冬生在 10 月 21 日的世界智能网联汽车大会上表示，L3 级有条件自动驾驶有希望在 2028 年落地。

Regarding higher levels of autonomous driving, he judged that after technological iteration, it might be implemented in another 1-2 years on this basis. 对于更高级别的自动驾驶，他判断，经过技术迭代，可能在此基础上再过 1—2 年落地。

item.title: 特斯拉三季度净利降 43%，管理层仍强调 FSD 技术领先
item.guid: 特斯拉三季度净利降-43%，管理层仍强调-FSD-技术领先
item.description:
Tesla announced its third-quarter results on October 21 local time: revenue was $28.046 billion, basically flat year-on-year; GAAP net profit attributable to the parent company was $787 million, a year-on-year decrease of 43%. The company attributed the decline in operating profit to increased investment in AI and R&D, reduced regulatory credit income, and rising expenses such as equity incentives. 特斯拉于当地时间 10 月 21 日公布三季度业绩：营收 280.46 亿美元，同比基本持平；GAAP 归母净利润 7.87 亿美元，同比下降 43%。公司将营业利润下滑归因于 AI 与研发投入增加、监管积分收入减少，以及股权激励等费用上升。

Key business and cash flow performance are as follows: 主要业务和现金流表现如下：

    Automotive business revenue was $20.56 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 3%; deliveries were 486,532 vehicles, a year-on-year decrease of 2%.

    Energy business revenue was $2.881 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 16%; service and other business revenue was $4.605 billion, a year-on-year increase of 33%.

    Overall gross margin was 19.6%, an increase of 1.6 percentage points year-on-year; operating profit was $718 million, a year-on-year decrease of 56%.

    Non-GAAP net profit attributable to the parent company was $1.697 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 4%; adjusted diluted earnings per share were $0.48. Free cash flow was $1.531 billion, which was negative last quarter.

During the conference call, CFO Vaibhav Taneja stated that FSD's technological advantage is currently unmatched by other Chinese automakers, and the company is still seeking broader approval from Chinese regulators. Musk called FSD the biggest driver of vehicle demand growth. The financial report shows that active FSD paid users increased to 1.74 million, a year-on-year increase of 67%. 在电话会上，CFO Vaibhav Taneja 称，FSD 的技术优势是目前其他中国车企所不具备的，公司仍在争取中国监管机构给予更广泛批准。马斯克则将 FSD 称为车辆需求增长的最大驱动力。财报显示，FSD 活跃付费用户增至 174 万，同比增长 67%。

Management adjusted the full-year capital expenditure guidance to approximately $20 billion, planning to primarily fund it with operating cash flow. 管理层将全年资本开支指引调整为约 200 亿美元，计划主要用经营现金流提供资金。

item.title: 王兴兴：物理 AI 已有突破苗头，难点在模型与机器人对齐
item.guid: 王兴兴：物理-AI-已有突破苗头，难点在模型与机器人对齐
item.description:
At the 2026 World Physical AI Conference and Unitree Partner Ecosystem Conference held on October 22, Wang Xingxing, founder of Unitree Robotics, stated that physical AI is showing signs of being 'broken through,' and related breakthroughs may appear in the next 1-2 years or 2-3 years. 在 10 月 22 日举行的 2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会上，宇树科技创始人王兴兴表示，物理 AI 已经看到被「击穿」的苗头，相关突破可能在未来 1—2 年或 2—3 年出现。

According to a report by *Science and Technology Innovation Board Daily*, he believes that almost everyone's attention to and belief in AI are still insufficient, including himself. 据《科创板日报》报道，他认为，几乎所有人对 AI 的重视程度和信仰都还不够，其中也包括他自己。

Regarding the basis for progress, Wang Xingxing stated in his keynote speech that for top large model companies, in a sense, internal self-evolution of models has largely been achieved: models write programs and collect data themselves, with humans only needing to provide appropriate guidance and participation. 谈及进展的依据，王兴兴在主旨演讲中称，对于顶尖大模型公司，某种意义上，内部已经基本实现模型的自进化：模型自己写程序、采集数据，人只需要适当引导和参与。

He also distinguished between the time for technological breakthroughs and widespread application. Wang Xingxing stated that it takes 5-10 years for a technological breakthrough to spread to everyone's use, so people's perception of these advancements is not yet profound. 他同时区分了技术突破与普遍应用的时间。王兴兴表示，从技术突破扩散到每个人都能使用，需要 5—10 年，因此人们对这些进展的感受还不那么深刻。

In his view, the most critical challenge for embodied AI to cross the 'ChatGPT moment' is the alignment of AI model input/output with real robots. As for the specific deployment order, he judges that commercial service scenarios will be faster than home and industrial sectors. 在他看来，具身智能迈过「ChatGPT 时刻」的最核心挑战，是 AI 模型的输入输出与真实机器人的对齐。至于具体落地顺序，他判断商业服务场景会比家庭、工业领域更快。

A live report from Yicai also documented an internal test: Wang Xingxing stated that by deploying GPT-6 onto a robot, without specifically programming it for brush washing or color changing, the robot could observe the adjacent paint palette, clean its brush independently, and continue painting. He believes that large models can already solve some planning problems, but fine assembly and complex object interaction still present numerous engineering challenges. 第一财经的现场报道还记录了一项内部测试：王兴兴称，把 GPT-6 部署到机器人上，在没有为洗笔、换色专门编写程序的情况下，机器人能观察旁边的颜料盘，自行清洗画笔并继续绘画。他认为，大模型已能解决部分规划问题，但精细装配和复杂物体交互仍有大量工程难点。

Unitree is also internally researching a robot self-evolution process: allowing the model to collect papers, write code, train first in simulation, then test in a real environment, and provide feedback to the model after scoring by AI or humans, continuing to rewrite code and solutions. At the end of his speech, he said he was 'really afraid of wasting every day,' as industry opportunities are abundant and competition is fierce. 宇树也在内部预研机器人自进化流程：让模型搜集论文、写代码，先在仿真中训练、再到真实环境测试，由 AI 或人打分后反馈给模型，继续改写代码与方案。他在演讲结尾说，自己「真的很害怕浪费每一天」，行业机会很多，竞争也很激烈。

item.title: 宝马与中国信通院续签合作，聚焦 AI 与下一代通信技术
item.guid: 宝马与中国信通院续签合作，聚焦-AI-与下一代通信技术
item.description:
BMW Group announced at the 2026 World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference that BMW (China) Services Ltd. and the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology have renewed their memorandum of cooperation, deepening collaboration around next-generation communication technologies, artificial intelligence, and other cutting-edge technologies. 宝马集团在 2026 世界智能网联汽车大会上宣布，宝马（中国）服务有限公司与中国信息通信研究院续签合作备忘录，将围绕下一代通信技术、人工智能及其他前沿技术深化合作。

The two parties first signed a cooperation agreement in 2019. The renewed cooperation content includes industry trend analysis, policy and standard research, joint research, and co-building an industrial ecosystem. 双方于 2019 年首次签署合作协议。此次续签的合作内容包括产业趋势研判、政策与标准研究、联合研究和产业生态共建。

BMW stated that the Chinese team is undertaking more work in demand definition, software development, testing and validation, and mass production applications. The new generation BMW iX3 and BMW i3, built for the Chinese market, will combine BMW's global engineering system with Chinese partners' technologies in electrification, intelligent driving, and digitalization. 宝马表示，中国团队正承担更多需求定义、软件开发、测试验证和量产应用工作。面向中国市场打造的新世代 BMW iX3 与 BMW i3，将结合宝马全球工程体系与中国伙伴在电动化、智能驾驶、数字化方面的技术。

item.title: OpenAI 据报接近敲定最高 300 亿美元融资，投前估值 1.25 万亿美元
item.guid: OpenAI-据报接近敲定最高-300-亿美元融资，投前估值-1.25-万亿美元
item.description:
According to CNBC, citing sources, OpenAI is close to finalizing a funding round of up to $30 billion, led by UAE investors and Coatue, with a pre-money valuation of $1.25 trillion. This valuation does not include the new funds raised in this round. 据 CNBC 援引知情人士报道，OpenAI 接近敲定一轮最高 300 亿美元的融资，由阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 牵头，投前估值为 1.25 万亿美元。该估值不包含本轮新募集的资金。

Sources said the funding round is positioned as bridge financing ahead of a potential IPO. OpenAI informed investors on October 22 that it hopes to complete the signing by next weekend, but the final funding size is still being determined. The company initiated discussions for a new funding round in September after receiving investor proposals. 知情人士称，这轮融资被定位为潜在 IPO 前的过桥融资。OpenAI 已于 10 月 22 日告知投资者，希望在下周末前完成签署，但最终融资规模仍在确定中。公司在 9 月收到投资者提议后启动了新一轮融资讨论。

In addition to equity financing, OpenAI is also negotiating a commercial agreement to obtain more computing power from the UAE. The company secretly submitted its prospectus to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in June this year, but has not yet announced a specific listing date; CFO Sarah Friar once told employees that the company would go public in 2027. 除股权融资外，OpenAI 还在谈判一项商业协议，以获得更多来自阿联酋的算力。公司今年 6 月已向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交招股文件，尚未公布具体上市时间；CFO Sarah Friar 曾向员工表示，公司将在 2027 年上市。

item.title: 西部数据季度营收增 55%，下季收入指引升至约 51 亿美元
item.guid: 西部数据季度营收增-55%，下季收入指引升至约-51-亿美元
item.description:
Western Digital announced its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 results as of October 2: revenue was $4.381 billion, a year-on-year increase of 55% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 17%; according to GAAP, diluted net profit attributable to common shareholders was $1.779 billion, a year-on-year increase of 54%, and diluted earnings per share were $4.63. 西部数据公布截至 10 月 2 日的 2027 财年第一财季业绩：营收 43.81 亿美元，同比增长 55%、环比增长 17%；按 GAAP 口径，归属普通股股东的稀释净利润为 17.79 亿美元，同比增长 54%，稀释每股收益为 4.63 美元。

Profitability continued to improve: GAAP gross margin was 57.8%, compared to 43.5% in the same period last year; operating profit was $2.046 billion, a year-on-year increase of 158%. According to non-GAAP, gross margin was 58.1%, and diluted earnings per share were $4.64. The company's operating cash flow for the quarter was $1.6 billion, and free cash flow was $1.38 billion. 盈利能力继续提高：GAAP 毛利率为 57.8%，去年同期为 43.5%；营业利润为 20.46 亿美元，同比增长 158%。按非 GAAP 口径，毛利率为 58.1%，稀释每股收益为 4.64 美元。公司当季经营现金流为 16 亿美元，自由现金流为 13.8 亿美元。

CFO Kris Sennesael stated that business continued to grow this quarter, with increased shipping capacity and improved pricing driving performance. The company expects second-quarter revenue to be $5.1 billion, plus or minus $100 million, non-GAAP gross margin to be 60%-61%, and diluted earnings per share to be $5.80, plus or minus $0.20. CFO Kris Sennesael 表示，本季业务保持增长，出货容量增长与定价改善推动业绩。公司预计第二财季营收为 51 亿美元、上下浮动 1 亿美元，非 GAAP 毛利率为 60%—61%，稀释每股收益为 5.80 美元、上下浮动 0.20 美元。

Western Digital also increased its quarterly dividend by 17% to $0.175 per share, with plans to distribute it on December 17 to shareholders on record at the close of business on December 4. 西部数据还将季度股息提高 17% 至每股 0.175 美元，计划于 12 月 17 日向 12 月 4 日收盘时在册的股东派发。

item.title: 💡 马斯克：未来人形机器人的数量将超过人类
item.guid: 💡-马斯克：未来人形机器人的数量将超过人类
item.description:
During Tesla's Q3 earnings call, Musk reiterated his belief that Optimus and the entire humanoid robot category will become the world's largest product. He said: 在特斯拉三季度财报电话会上，马斯克重申，他相信 Optimus 及整个人形机器人品类将成为全球最大的产品。他说：

I believe that at some point in the future, the number of humanoid robots on Earth will exceed humans.

His reasoning is that the utility of robots is roughly determined by the product of electromechanical dexterity, AI software, and AI chips; he believes that improvements in these three aspects, superimposed on each other, coupled with the cycle of robots participating in the manufacturing of the next batch of robots, will drive rapid growth in production capacity and capability. 他的理由是，机器人的实用性大致由机电灵巧程度、AI 软件和 AI 芯片三者相乘决定；他认为，三方面的改进彼此叠加，加上机器人参与制造下一批机器人的循环，将推动产能和能力快速增长。

Musk also cautioned that Optimus still needs to address issues such as hand durability, dexterity, AI, and lifespan. The hands must be able to work repeatedly for a long time, be soft enough, and not damage sensors when grasping delicate objects. He expects these conditions to be largely in place by the end of 2027 for delivery to companies other than Tesla. 马斯克也提醒，Optimus 仍需要解决手部耐用性、灵巧性、AI 与使用寿命等问题。手要能长期反复工作，也要足够柔软，抓取精细物品时不能损坏传感器。他预计到 2027 年末，这些条件才可能基本到位，向特斯拉以外企业交付。

Regarding training methods, he stated that robots do not have the vast existing data collection fleets that cars do. It will be necessary to first manufacture tens of thousands of robots, practice various tasks in the Optimus Academy, and then use that experience to improve the models. Robots must first observe humans, then repeatedly practice in simulated and real environments; just watching others play soccer doesn't mean you can play soccer yourself. 谈到训练方法，他表示，机器人没有汽车那样庞大的现成数据采集车队，需要先制造上万台机器人，在 Optimus Academy 中练习各种任务，再把经验用于改进模型。机器人要先观察人类，再在仿真和现实环境中反复练习；只看别人踢球，不代表自己就会踢球。

As for the initial uses, he believes priority should be given to dangerous, repetitive, and round-the-clock tasks in industrial settings, and then expand to households as production scales up. 至于最初的用途，他认为应优先承担工业场景中危险、重复、需要全天候进行的任务，随着产量扩大，再面向家庭。

item.title: 乐奇 Rokid Color 意外曝光，彩显 AI 眼镜或将亮相
item.guid: 乐奇-Rokid-Color-意外曝光，彩显-AI-眼镜或将亮相
item.description:
According to AR circles, on October 22, a WeChat Moments video posted by Rokid founder Zhu Mingming (Misa) unexpectedly revealed the suspected product name and logo of a color display AI glasses, with the words 'Rokid Color' appearing in the identifier. 据 AR 圈报道，10 月 22 日，乐奇 Rokid 创始人祝铭明（Misa）发布的一条朋友圈视频，意外曝光了疑似彩显 AI 眼镜的产品名称和 Logo，标识中出现「Rokid Color」字样。

From the video footage, this content appears to have been shot by the camera on the AI glasses. The product watermark at the bottom of the video is different from Rokid's existing product watermarks, and a horse head pattern also appears in the logo, the specific meaning of which is currently unclear. Due to the small size of the logo in the original video, related reports also used AI technology to restore it, for reference only. 从视频画面来看，这段内容疑似由 AI 眼镜上的摄像头拍摄。视频底部的产品水印与乐奇现有产品的水印不同，Logo 中还出现了一个马头图案，其具体含义暂不清楚。由于原视频中的 Logo 尺寸较小，相关报道还使用 AI 技术对其进行了还原，仅供参考。

The name 'Rokid Color' and its color scheme may suggest that the product will adopt a color display solution. Rokid will hold a press conference on October 27, and this suspected color display AI glasses may be unveiled. 「Rokid Color」这一名称及其配色，或暗示该产品将采用彩色显示方案。乐奇将于 10 月 27 日举办发布会，这款疑似彩显 AI 眼镜或有望亮相。

item.title: 高德将为 iPhone Duo 推出分屏导航，车道与远方路线并排显示
item.guid: 高德将为-iPhone-Duo-推出分屏导航，车道与远方路线并排显示
item.description:
Amap announced the completion of its adaptation for the iPhone Duo foldable form factor and will launch a split-screen navigation function: the left side displays lane-level navigation, and the right side displays the route ahead and traffic conditions on a regular map. The two views are presented side-by-side, respectively providing immediate lane guidance and longer-distance route viewing. 高德宣布完成对 iPhone Duo 折叠形态的适配，并将推出分屏导航功能：左侧显示车道级导航，右侧显示常规地图上的前方路线与路况。两种视野并排呈现，分别承担眼前的车道引导和更远距离的路线查看。

Currently, Amap supports automatic adjustment of interface layout with inner and outer screen switching and device orientation changes. Location exploration also adopts a dual-column design, allowing users to browse locations, street-ranking lists, and recommended information on the left, while viewing restaurant locations on the right; Amap can also be displayed in split-screen with other applications. 目前，高德已支持随内外屏切换、设备方向变化自动调整界面布局。地点探索也采用双栏设计，用户可在左侧浏览地点、扫街榜榜单及推荐信息，同时在右侧查看餐厅位置；还可将高德与其他应用分屏显示。

According to Amap's official instructions, updating the App to the latest version will allow users to experience existing adaptations; driving split-screen navigation will be launched in subsequent updates. Amap claims this is the first split-screen navigation function for foldable iPhones. 按高德官方说明，将 App 更新至最新版本即可体验已有适配；驾车分屏导航将在后续更新中上线。高德称，这是首个面向可折叠 iPhone 的分屏导航功能。

item.title: 蘑菇灯 Mori 会看人、会跳舞，创始版售价 649 美元
item.guid: 蘑菇灯-Mori-会看人、会跳舞，创始版售价-649-美元
item.description:
Startup OKA launched its first product, Mori: a mushroom-shaped robot lamp with a camera, microphone, and movable head. When someone comes home, it looks up, makes a soft sound, and moves; after touching the top, its face retracts into the lampshade, entering a natural soundscape and light companionship mode. 初创公司 OKA 推出首款产品 Mori：一盏带有摄像头、麦克风和活动头部的蘑菇形机器人灯。有人回家时，它会抬头、发出轻声并做出动作；触碰顶部后，面部缩回灯罩，进入自然声景与灯光陪伴模式。

According to WIRED's interview with CEO Hua Wang, Mori can dance to music, respond to human movements, and guide breathing exercises, but it does not currently support voice control of smart homes, playing specific songs, or checking the weather. Its AI processes images and sounds locally on the device, and original files are subsequently discarded; facial feature data is encrypted and stored on the device, not uploaded to the cloud. 据 WIRED 对 CEO Hua Wang 的采访，Mori 可以随着音乐起舞、回应人的动作，并引导呼吸练习，但暂时不支持用语音控制智能家居、播放指定歌曲或查询天气。其 AI 在设备本地处理图像和声音，原始文件随后丢弃；面部特征数据加密保存在设备上，不上传云端。

The founder's edition went on sale on October 22, limited to hundreds of units, priced at $649, including a two-year warranty and a two-year subscription. The standard edition is priced at $799, without subscription services; breathing exercises are free to use, while natural soundscapes require a subscription. According to the company's instructions, the camera turns off when the head retracts, and double-tapping the top can turn off the microphone. 创始版于 10 月 22 日开售，限量数百台，售价 649 美元，包含两年保修和两年订阅。标准版售价 799 美元，不含订阅服务；呼吸练习可免费使用，自然声景则需要订阅。按公司说明，头部缩回时摄像头关闭，双击顶部可关闭麦克风。

item.title: 影石推出更便宜的无线麦克风，保留彩色墨水屏、改用存储卡备份
item.guid: 影石推出更便宜的无线麦克风，保留彩色墨水屏、改用存储卡备份
item.description:
Insta360 has released the Insta360 Mic, positioned between the Mic Air and Mic Pro. The new model retains the front 1.22-inch six-color e-ink screen, which can display photos, logos, or solid colors; according to The Verge, the single transmitter is priced at $79.99 overseas, and the dual transmitter, receiver, and charging case set is $249.99. 影石发布 Insta360 Mic，定位介于 Mic Air 和 Mic Pro 之间。新款保留正面的 1.22 英寸六色电子墨水屏，可显示照片、Logo 或纯色；按 The Verge 报道，单发射器海外售价为 79.99 美元，双发射器、接收器及充电盒套装为 249.99 美元。

Compared to the Mic Pro's three-microphone array, the new model uses a single microphone, offering only omnidirectional pickup. The transmitter weighs 19.4g, and its maximum single-charge battery life has increased from the Mic Pro's 10 hours to 13 hours, extending to 34 hours with the charging case. 与 Mic Pro 的三麦克风阵列相比，新款采用单麦克风，只提供全指向拾音。发射器重量为 19.4g，单次最长续航由 Mic Pro 的 10 小时增至 13 小时，配合充电盒可达 34 小时。

The new model has no built-in storage but can insert a microSD card for backup recording. It retains AI noise reduction and automatic gain control, with a maximum transmission distance of 400 meters when paired with a receiver, and can also connect to mobile phones and some Insta360 cameras via Bluetooth. 新款没有内置存储，可插入 microSD 卡进行备份录音。它保留 AI 降噪和自动增益控制，配接收器最远传输距离为 400 米，也能通过蓝牙连接手机及部分影石相机。

item.title: OpenAI 决策 API 正式开放，一次可处理 400 个判断问题
item.guid: OpenAI-决策-API-正式开放，一次可处理-400-个判断问题
item.description:
OpenAI announced on October 22nd that the Decisions API has concluded its public beta and is now officially open, currently utilizing the GPT-6 Luna model. It is designed for scenarios such as content classification, request routing, and task prioritization, directly returning the probability of a condition being met, preset options, or scores. OpenAI 于 10 月 22 日宣布，Decisions API 结束公开测试并正式开放，目前使用 GPT-6 Luna 模型。它面向内容分类、请求路由和任务优先级排序等场景，直接返回条件成立的概率、预设选项或评分。

Compared to the public beta phase, the number of questions supported per single request has increased from 200 to 400, and new capabilities such as shared input caching, embedded images in question instructions, and direct JSON input have been added. The official statement claims that the response speed for these judgment tasks is approximately 10 times faster than the Responses API. 相较公开测试阶段，单次请求支持的问题数由 200 个增至 400 个，并新增共享输入缓存、问题指令内附图和直接传入 JSON 等能力。官方称，这类判断任务的响应速度约为 Responses API 的 10 倍。

The price for uncached input to this API is $0.10 per million tokens, with no charge for output tokens; shared input cache hits receive a discount. It can also integrate with GPT-Live, triggering judgments when a user speaks or a speech model outputs. 该接口的未缓存输入价格为每百万 token 0.10 美元，不收取输出 token 费用；共享输入命中缓存可享折扣。它也能接入 GPT-Live，在用户说话或语音模型输出时触发判断。

item.title: 一加 Ace 7 系列定档 10 月 29 日，双路风冷分别吹向芯片与后盖
item.guid: 一加-Ace-7-系列定档-10-月-29-日，双路风冷分别吹向芯片与后盖
item.description:
The OnePlus Ace 7 series new product launch event is scheduled for October 29th at 19:00, and the official announcement poster has revealed the new phone's appearance. 一加 Ace 7 系列新品发布会定于 10 月 29 日 19:00 举行，官方定档海报已公布新机外观。

Li Jie, President of OnePlus China, introduced that the new phone adopts a "dual-path glacier air-cooling system": one path blows air directly onto the chip, and the other blows across the back cover, separately managing performance release and heat in the grip area. The cooling structure also uses tower fins similar to those in gaming graphics cards, and allows the fan to work in conjunction with temperature control algorithms. 一加中国区总裁李杰介绍，新机采用「双路冰河风冷系统」：一路出风直吹芯片，另一路吹过后盖，分别处理性能释放与握持区域发热。散热结构还采用游戏显卡同类的塔式鳍片，并让风扇与温控算法协同工作。

Li Jie listed maintaining game frame rates and reducing long-duration gaming temperatures as the goals of this solution; the official poster uses "Performance Soars, A Cross-Generational Masterpiece" as the launch theme. 李杰将维持游戏帧率和降低长时间游戏温度列为这套方案的目标；官方海报以「性能直升，跨代之作」为发布主题。

item.title: HHKB 30 周年纪念键盘采用整块铝材外壳，全球限量 300 台
item.guid: HHKB-30-周年纪念键盘采用整块铝材外壳，全球限量-300-台
item.description:
PFU has released the HHKB Professional Elite keyboard for HHKB's 30th anniversary, featuring a casing milled from a single block of aluminum. It is limited to 300 units worldwide, with 250 units for the Japanese market and 50 for the Chinese market. The tax-included price in Japan is 330,000 JPY. PFU 为 HHKB 诞生 30 周年发布 HHKB Professional Elite 键盘，采用整块铝材切削外壳，全球限量 300 台，其中日本市场 250 台、中国市场 50 台，日本含税售价为 33 万日元。

The new keyboard is based on the 2006 HHKB Professional HG commemorative model. Its casing has been sandblasted and anodized, featuring Type-S silent electrostatic capacitive keys and a redesigned internal mounting structure. The bottom is engraved with an independent limited edition number, and the two accompanying feet can be combined in different orientations to achieve four levels of tilt adjustment. 新键盘以 2006 年的 HHKB Professional HG 纪念款为基础，外壳经过喷砂与阳极氧化处理，采用 Type-S 静音静电容按键和重新设计的内部安装结构。底部刻有独立限量编号，配套的两种支脚可通过安装方向组合，实现四档倾角调节。

The Elite offers an English layout and uses a wired connection. The Japanese market will accept lottery applications for priority purchase from October 22nd to 28th, with general sales opening on December 7th. Priority sales products are expected to be shipped sequentially starting from March 2027; the 50 units for China will be subject to separate applications by the local general agent. Elite 提供英文配列，采用有线连接。日本市场于 10 月 22 日至 28 日接受先行购买资格抽签，12 月 7 日起开放一般销售，先行销售产品预计于 2027 年 3 月起陆续发货；中国的 50 台由当地总代理另行接受申请。

item.title: 智元开源具身推理数据集，让机器人按现场条件决定怎么做
item.guid: 智元开源具身推理数据集，让机器人按现场条件决定怎么做
item.description:
On October 22nd, Zhiyuan open-sourced the fourth phase of the AGIBOT WORLD 2026 "Embodied Reasoning" dataset, designed to train robots to select their next action based on goals, real-world conditions, and execution constraints in actual tasks. 10 月 22 日，智元开源 AGIBOT WORLD 2026 第四期「具身推理」数据集，围绕真实任务中的目标、现场状态与执行约束，训练机器人选择下一步行动。

Different initial conditions are set for the same task. For example, to replenish mini-bar drinks to 3 bottles, the robot first needs to identify empty bottles, count the quantity, and then decide on the recycling and replenishment steps; when searching for items in multiple drawers, it must remember locations it has already checked. 同一个任务会设置不同的初始条件。例如把迷你吧饮料补到 3 瓶，机器人需要先辨别空瓶、清点数量，再决定回收与补货步骤；从多个抽屉寻找物品时，则要记住已经查过的位置。

This phase covers nine types of capabilities, including attribute constraint selection, precondition reasoning, goal-oriented search, quantity and state reasoning, and long-range planning. It also provides high-level Q&A, task stages, detailed action descriptions, and real-machine action trajectory annotations, including both successful and erroneous samples. 本期覆盖属性约束选择、前置条件推理、目标导向搜索、数量与状态推理、长程规划等九类能力，同时提供高层问答、任务阶段、详细动作描述与真机动作轨迹标注，包含成功和错误样本。

Zhiyuan states that this batch of data has been used for training its upcoming Agent framework and next-generation foundation models. The official Hugging Face repository uses the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, with data sourced from real-world scenarios; accompanying simulation data is also available in the GenieSim project. 智元称，这批数据已用于其即将推出的 Agent 框架与新一代基座模型训练。官方 Hugging Face 仓库采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可，数据来自真实场景；配套仿真数据另在 GenieSim 项目开放。

item.title: Hugging Face 开源 Carbon-X，让研究人员用对话分析 DNA
item.guid: Hugging-Face-开源-Carbon-X，让研究人员用对话分析-DNA
item.description:
Hugging Face, in collaboration with Beijing Zhongguancun College and an Italian genetic and medical research institution, has launched Carbon-X. Researchers can input DNA sequences into a chat window to inquire whether mutations might be pathogenic, which regions affect gene activity, and receive predictions and explanations. Hugging Face 联合北京中关村学院、意大利遗传与医学研究机构推出 Carbon-X。研究人员可以把 DNA 序列放进聊天窗口，询问突变是否可能致病、哪些区域影响基因活动，并获得预测及解释。

This model is based on continued training of Qwen3-14B, with an actual parameter count of approximately 14.8 billion. The team added DNA-specific encoding to the text vocabulary, where each DNA token corresponds to 6 bases, and then trained it with DNA, biological text, and instruction data, allowing sequences and natural language to share the same model. 这款模型基于 Qwen3-14B 继续训练，实际参数量约 148 亿。团队为文本词表加入 DNA 专用编码，每个 DNA token 对应 6 个碱基，再以 DNA、生物学文本和指令数据训练，使序列与自然语言共用同一个模型。

In the 5 DNA benchmark tests published by the team, Carbon-X with thinking mode off achieved an average score of 66.7%, while GPT-6.1 Sol's corresponding highest configuration scored 67.5%. The model weights are licensed under Apache 2.0 and can be deployed locally; the official BF16 deployment configuration can fit on a single 80GB GPU. 在团队公布的 5 项 DNA 基准测试中，关闭思考模式的 Carbon-X 平均得分为 66.7%，GPT-6.1 Sol 的对应最高配置为 67.5%。模型权重采用 Apache 2.0 许可，可在本地部署；官方给出的 BF16 部署配置可放入单张 80GB GPU。

The team emphasizes that it has not yet undergone clinical validation and cannot be used for medical decisions; it may produce incorrect interpretations for sequences lacking context, and has limitations in long sequence generation and precise localization. 团队强调，它尚未经过临床验证，不能用于医疗决策；对缺少上下文的序列可能产生错误解释，长序列生成和精确定位也有局限。

item.title: 小鹏 IRON 学会跟着人临时变招，每 0.2 秒重新判断动作
item.guid: 小鹏-IRON-学会跟着人临时变招，每-0.2-秒重新判断动作
item.description:
Xpeng Motors released an interactive demonstration of its IRON humanoid robot, showcasing its response to temporary changes in actions during handshakes, fist bumps, and high-fives: if a person suddenly changes their palm to a fist, or alters the high-five position, the robot will also adjust its response. 小鹏汽车发布 IRON 人形机器人的交互演示，展示握手、碰拳、击掌时对临时动作变化的响应：人将手掌突然改成拳头，或改变击掌位置，机器人也会调整回应。

According to Xpeng, the upgraded second-generation VLA large model is already running on the IRON robot's edge device. The robot re-infers based on the current visual input every 0.2 seconds and predicts action changes within the next 6 seconds, using continuous observation and adjustment instead of executing a complete set of actions after a single gesture recognition. 据小鹏介绍，升级后的第二代 VLA 大模型已在 IRON 端侧运行。机器人每 0.2 秒根据当前画面重新推理一次，并预测未来 6 秒内的动作变化，以持续观察和调整代替识别一次手势后执行整套动作。

item.title: 1Password for Agents 发布，密码由用户批准后直接填入网页
item.guid: 1Password-for-Agents-发布，密码由用户批准后直接填入网页
item.description:
1Password has released 1Password for Agents, designed for personal AI agents, allowing agents to log into websites after user approval, without passwords entering the AI model's context or being saved by the agent. 1Password 发布面向个人 AI 智能体的 1Password for Agents，让智能体在获得用户批准后登录网站，密码无需进入 AI 模型的上下文，也不交给智能体保存。

When an agent encounters a login form, it first authenticates with 1Password using a dedicated digital key. Users can then view on their own device which login credentials the agent is requesting to use and for what purpose, before choosing to approve or deny. Once approved, 1Password directly fills out the web form, and the agent continues its original task. 当智能体遇到登录表单，会先用专属数字密钥向 1Password 验明身份。用户在自己的设备上查看它申请使用哪项登录凭据、用途是什么，再选择批准或拒绝。获批后，1Password 直接填写网页表单，智能体继续完成原来的任务。

The company is advancing integrations with products such as Meta Muse, Anthropic Claude Duet, OpenAI ChatGPT Work and dots, Grok Bot, and Town, and has also listed future partners like Browserbase and Perplexity. Integration progress varies; Anthropic stated in its announcement that Claude Duet will integrate with 1Password for login in the future. 公司正与 Meta Muse、Anthropic Claude Duet、OpenAI ChatGPT Work 和 dots、Grok Bot、Town 等产品推进集成，也列出了 Browserbase、Perplexity 等后续合作伙伴。各项集成进度有所不同，Anthropic 在公告中表示，Claude Duet 将在后续接入 1Password 完成登录。

item.title: Amp 开放 Orbs 自托管，可在自己的 Mac 和云端运行 Agent
item.guid: Amp-开放-Orbs-自托管，可在自己的-Mac-和云端运行-Agent
item.description:
AI programming tool Amp opened Orbs self-hosting on October 22nd, allowing users to provide computing resources, which Amp organizes into independent development environments for agents to work in. Official examples for connecting Docker, Apple containers, Kubernetes, and various cloud environments were provided. AI 编程工具 Amp 于 10 月 22 日开放 Orbs 自托管，允许用户提供计算资源，由 Amp 将其组织成供智能体工作的独立开发环境。官方给出了 Docker、Apple 容器、Kubernetes 及多种云端环境的接入示例。

The local provider program actively connects to Amp, receiving requests to create, pause, and delete environments, without needing to open inbound ports to the internal network. The recovery capabilities of different infrastructures vary: Docker can retain disk files but not memory before pausing, and terminal sessions and desktop applications will not be restored exactly as they were. 本地的 provider 程序主动连接 Amp，接收创建、暂停和删除环境的请求，无需向内网开放入站端口。不同基础设施的恢复能力有所区别：Docker 可以保留磁盘文件，但不能保留暂停前的内存，终端会话和桌面应用不会原样恢复。

Self-hosting does not mean the entire service runs offline. Amp is still responsible for conversations and task coordination, and file content read by agents, command output, and code changes will still pass through Amp and may be sent to model providers. 自托管不等于整套服务离线运行。Amp 仍负责对话和任务协调，智能体读取的文件内容、命令输出及代码变更仍会经过 Amp，并可能发送给模型提供商。

This feature is free for all workspaces until October 29th; thereafter, Hobby, Individual, and Teams plans will remain free, while Enterprise will be charged at standard Orbs compute prices; users will also need to bear their own infrastructure costs. 该功能在 10 月 29 日前对所有工作区免费，此后 Hobby、Individual 和 Teams 计划继续免费，Enterprise 按标准 Orbs 算力价格计费；用户还需自行承担基础设施费用。

item.title: 富士通推出哥斯拉联名笔记本，连鼠标光标都变成脚印
item.guid: 富士通推出哥斯拉联名笔记本，连鼠标光标都变成脚印
item.description:
Fujitsu Client Computing launched the FMV Zero GODZILLA EDITION collaboration laptop on October 22nd, in partnership with the movie "Godzilla Minus One." It is now available for pre-order on the official Japanese store, with shipments planned to begin in late November. 富士通客户端计算于 10 月 22 日推出 FMV Zero GODZILLA EDITION 联名笔记本，与电影《哥斯拉-0.0》合作，即日起在日本官方商城接受订购，计划 11 月下旬开始供货。

This laptop features Godzilla drawn in black ink on its pure black lid, a touchpad printed with dorsal fins, an Enter key with the "G-0.0" logo, and an exclusive nameplate on the bottom. When switched to the Windows Godzilla theme, three original wallpapers can be rotated, and the mouse cursor transforms into Godzilla footprints. 这款电脑在纯黑机身顶盖上用黑色墨水绘制哥斯拉，触控板印有背鳍，回车键加入「G-0.0」标志，底部还有专属铭牌。切换到 Windows 的 Godzilla 主题后，三张原创壁纸可轮播，鼠标光标也会变成哥斯拉脚印。

The body features a magnesium alloy casing and has passed MIL-STD-810H standard tests. The collaboration also extends to the power adapter: a matching 65W USB-C adapter will be sold separately, also planned for late November delivery. 机身采用镁合金外壳，并通过 MIL-STD-810H 标准测试。联名还延伸到电源适配器：同主题的 65W USB-C 适配器会单独销售，同样计划于 11 月下旬供货。

"Godzilla Minus One" will be released in Japan on November 3rd; the collaboration laptop will also be showcased at the Godzilla Festival held on the same day. 《哥斯拉-0.0》将于 11 月 3 日在日本上映；联名电脑也将在当天举办的哥斯拉节上展示。

item.title: Miu Miu 三季度零售销售额降 3%，Prada 品牌增长 1%
item.guid: Miu-Miu-三季度零售销售额降-3%，Prada-品牌增长-1%
item.description:
Prada Group announced its Q3 revenue update, with its Miu Miu brand's retail sales declining 3% year-on-year at constant exchange rates in the third quarter, while the Prada brand grew 1% during the same period. Miu Miu grew 29% in the same period last year and faces a high comparison base and impact from the Middle East market this year; excluding the Middle East region, its Q3 performance was roughly flat. Prada 集团公布前三季度收入更新，旗下 Miu Miu 品牌第三季度零售销售额按固定汇率同比下降 3%，Prada 品牌同期增长 1%。Miu Miu 去年同期增长 29%，今年面临较高比较基数及中东市场影响；剔除中东地区后，其第三季度表现大致持平。

The group's net revenue for the first three quarters was 4.541 billion euros, a year-on-year increase of 12% at reported exchange rates and 15% at constant exchange rates; organic growth, excluding the consolidation of Versace and exchange rate effects, was 4%. Of this, Versace contributed 441 million euros in net revenue. 集团前三季度净收入为 45.41 亿欧元，按报表汇率同比增长 12%，按固定汇率增长 15%；剔除 Versace 并表和汇率影响后的有机增长为 4%。其中，Versace 贡献净收入 4.41 亿欧元。

The group's net revenue for the third quarter grew 11% at constant exchange rates, with organic growth at 1%. The Americas remained the best-performing market, while Asia-Pacific and Japan were generally stable; the Middle East region improved compared to the previous quarter but still dragged down brand performance. 集团第三季度净收入按固定汇率增长 11%，有机增长为 1%。美洲仍是表现最好的市场，亚太与日本整体平稳；中东地区较上一季度改善，但仍拖累品牌表现。

item.title: WALLHACK 推出《剑风传奇》联名鼠标垫，格斯原画铺满玻璃
item.guid: WALLHACK-推出《剑风传奇》联名鼠标垫，格斯原画铺满玻璃
item.description:
Danish esports peripheral brand WALLHACK launched the "Berserk" collaboration SP-005 glass mouse pad on October 22nd, with an official international price of $139 USD. 丹麦电竞外设品牌 WALLHACK 于 10 月 22 日推出《剑风传奇》联名款 SP-005 玻璃鼠标垫，官方海外定价为 139 美元。

The design features the classic image of Guts in his Berserker Armor, wielding the Dragon Slayer sword, with Kentaro Miura's original line art and shading presented on a 44cm × 51cm glass surface. The black and white image is paired with a red silicone base, and it comes with a hard storage case and "Brand of Sacrifice" themed stickers. 图案选用格斯身穿狂战士铠甲、手持屠龙剑的经典画面，将三浦建太郎原作的排线与阴影呈现在 44cm × 51cm 的玻璃表面。黑白画面配红色硅胶底座，附有硬质收纳盒和「烙印」主题贴纸。

The product retains the SP-005's uncoated tempered glass surface and textured grid silicone base, with a total thickness of 3.3mm. "Berserk" is a dark fantasy manga created by Kentaro Miura, serialized since 1989, with the story revolving around Guts' experiences in a world of swords, magic, and monsters. 产品沿用 SP-005 的无涂层钢化玻璃表面与凹纹网格硅胶底层，总厚度为 3.3mm。《剑风传奇》是三浦建太郎创作的黑暗奇幻漫画，1989 年开始连载，故事围绕格斯在剑、魔法与魔物世界中的经历展开。

item.title: 《影之刃零》发布最终预告，10 月 27 日开启预下载
item.guid: 《影之刃零》发布最终预告，10-月-27-日开启预下载
item.description:
The official "Phantom Blade Zero" released its final trailer and confirmed that pre-downloads will begin on all platforms on October 27th at 10:00 AM, with official unlocking on October 29th at 10:00 AM. The PS5 physical disc will be released in 2027. 《影之刃零》官方发布最终预告，并确认 10 月 27 日 10:00 开启全平台预下载，10 月 29 日 10:00 正式解锁。PS5 实体光碟则将在 2027 年推出。

This single-player action role-playing game, developed by Game Science, uses Unreal Engine 5, combining wuxia narrative with elements like mechanical prosthetics and industrial ruins. Players take on the role of "Soul," a swordsman whose heart has been severely damaged and has only 66 days left to live, pursuing a conspiracy that engulfs the martial arts world while being hunted. 这款由灵游坊开发的单人动作角色扮演游戏使用虚幻引擎 5，将武侠叙事与机械义肢、工业遗迹等元素结合。玩家扮演心脏遭受重创、仅剩 66 天生命的剑客「魂」，在追杀中追查一场笼罩武林的阴谋。

According to the official Steam store description, the game offers over 30 main weapons and more than 20 special armaments, with combat integrating evasion, blocking, counterattacks, and combos; the game will be available on PC and PS5. Steam 官方商店介绍，游戏提供 30 余种主武器和 20 多种特殊武装，战斗融合闪避、格挡、反击与连招；游戏将登陆 PC 与 PS5。

item.title: 《天作不合的我们》第三季回归
item.guid: 《天作不合的我们》第三季回归
item.description:
Netflix romantic comedy "Nobody Wants This" returns for its third season on October 22, with 10 episodes. Kristen Bell and Adam Brody continue to portray podcast host Joanne and Rabbi Noah, who begin to move into the same house after the ups and downs of the previous season. Netflix 浪漫喜剧《天作不合的我们》（Nobody Wants This）第三季于 10 月 22 日回归，共 10 集。Kristen Bell 与 Adam Brody 继续饰演播客主持人 Joanne 和拉比 Noah，两人在经历上一季的波折后，开始搬进同一间屋子。

Creator Erin Foster stated that this season aims to keep the flirting and romance alive between the two in a stable relationship, with the story revolving around a series of "firsts" in their shared life. 主创 Erin Foster 表示，这一季希望让两人在稳定关系中继续保持调情与浪漫，故事会围绕共同生活中的一连串「第一次」展开。

The lives of friends and family take another direction: Sasha and Esther re-enter the dating world after separating, and new tensions arise in Sasha and Morgan's friendship; as the podcast continues to grow, Morgan's career begins to exceed Joanne's expectations. 亲友的生活则走向另一个方向：Sasha 与 Esther 分居后重新进入约会世界，Sasha 与 Morgan 的友谊也出现新的张力；随着播客继续发展，Morgan 的事业开始超出 Joanne 的预期。

Original cast members including Justine Lupe, Timothy Simons, and Jackie Tohn continue to return. Justine Lupe、Timothy Simons 与 Jackie Tohn 等原班演员继续回归。

item.title: Fleetwood Mac 首部全授权纪录片定档，明年 1 月登陆 Apple TV
item.guid: Fleetwood-Mac-首部全授权纪录片定档，明年-1-月登陆-Apple-TV
item.description:
Apple announced that "Fleetwood Mac: The Chain," the first fully authorized documentary about the band, will premiere globally on Apple TV on January 29, 2027, directed by Frank Marshall. Apple 宣布，Fleetwood Mac 首部获得乐队完整授权的纪录片《Fleetwood Mac: The Chain》将于 2027 年 1 月 29 日在 Apple TV 全球上线，由 Frank Marshall 执导。

The film will present the voices, memories, and perspectives of Mick Fleetwood, John McVie, Christine McVie, Lindsey Buckingham, and Stevie Nicks through unreleased footage and exclusive new interviews, looking back at over 50 years of the band's recordings, tours, and the complex and enduring connections between its members. 影片将通过未公开过的影像和独家新采访，呈现 Mick Fleetwood、John McVie、Christine McVie、Lindsey Buckingham 与 Stevie Nicks 的声音、回忆及视角，回顾这支乐队逾 50 年的录音、巡演，以及成员间复杂而持续的联系。

The title is taken from "The Chain" from "Rumours," the only song on the album credited to all five members. The documentary's release date also coincides with the 50th anniversary of "Rumours." Producers include The Kennedy/Marshall Company and White Horse Pictures. 片名取自《Rumours》中的〈The Chain〉，这是专辑里唯一署名归于五位成员共同创作的歌曲。纪录片上线时间也与《Rumours》发行 50 周年相呼应。制作方包括 The Kennedy/Marshall Company 和 White Horse Pictures。
